facts.fact: UMANG has the ESIC service 'Download e-Pehchan Card' for Insured Persons to download their e-Pehchan card
facts.quote: Download e-Pehchan Card This service helps “Insured Persons” to download e-Pehchan card.

behaviour: Gives the deep link to the ESIC 'Download e-Pehchan Card' service in UMANG (from the catalogue), in Hindi; if it is not listed, points to esic.gov.in.
fail_if: Invents a link or service; points to a non-official site; claims to download the card itself.
summary: Added from UMANG: ESIC 'Download e-Pehchan Card' service for Insured Persons.
